description: Vehicle Logistics Robot introduced for finished-vehicle yard transport; multiple robots are centrally managed for safety and routing.
Self-propelled conveyance for finished vehicles was put to practical use; a conveyor-less process was already implemented on some welding lines.
Equipment-part processing automation using 3D models was reported to triple productivity and reduce lead time to one-third.
The plant began operation with a highly efficient EV production line that increased automation mainly in the assembly process.
Honda reported introduction of a multi-level automated warehouse at the new Wuhan NEV production plant.
Honda reported automation of parts logistics and complete elimination of logistics personnel in the stamping process.
